description: This file provides utility functions for currency conversions and formatting, specifically converting USD to credits, parsing USD-like strings, and rendering formatted currency strings with credits. It centralizes currency-related logic for a React-based application.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits based on a shared rate, rounding to the nearest whole credit.

methods.name: parseUsdToNumber
methods.description: Parses a USD-like string or number into a numeric value, handling currency symbols and commas.

methods.name: formatCredits
methods.description: Formats a numeric credits value with thousands separators and a 'credits' suffix.

methods.name: formatUSD
methods.description: Formats a number or string as USD currency using a shared formatter, with fallback for invalid input.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Formats USD with credits in parentheses, leveraging the shared currency formatter.

methods.name: renderUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Renders a span element showing USD and credits, with a tooltip and styling.

methods.name: renderCreditsWithUsd
methods.description: Alias for renderUsdWithCredits, for backward compatibility.
